content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":false,"reason":"Specialty property and casualty insurer and annuity writer, earning premiums rather than fees on managed assets."},{"label":"C2","good":true,"reason":"Affiliated boutique investment manager selling funds and separate accounts to institutions and advisers, earning management fees on assets."},{"label":"C3","good":true,"reason":"Asset manager selling mutual funds, ETFs and separate accounts to institutions and advisers, earning AUM-based fees."},{"label":"C4","good":false,"reason":"Life insurer and annuity provider whose core business is insurance underwriting and retirement plan administration."},{"label":"C5","good":true,"reason":"Investment manager running mutual funds, ETFs and separate accounts for advisers and institutions on assets-under-management fees."},{"label":"C6","good":false,"reason":"Insurer selling annuities and life policies to individuals, earning investment income on policyholder funds."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Alternatives manager selling hedge, private equity and credit funds mainly to institutions, not public funds sold through advisers."},{"label":"C8","good":false,"reason":"Health savings account custodian and benefits platform serving employers and employees, not an investment manager."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Primarily an research, data and software subscription business; its portfolio management is a small side service."},{"label":"C10","good":false,"reason":"Operates over-the-counter trading venues and issuer disclosure services, not an investment management business."},{"label":"C11","good":false,"reason":"Private markets fund-of-funds and lender focused on private equity, venture debt and loans, not public fund management."},{"label":"C12","good":true,"reason":"Fee-based investment manager running separate accounts and pooled funds for affluent clients and institutions."},{"label":"C13","good":false,"reason":"Provides fund administration software and outsourced back-office operations, a technology and services business rather than asset management."},{"label":"C14","good":false,"reason":"Insurance brokerage earning commissions from carriers on placed policies, with no investment product business."}]}
